figures.caption: Map: Tribes of Arabia

sourceNote: Printed page 8: a full-page map of Arabia titled “قبائلِ عرب” (Tribes of Arabia) showing the names of many tribes and places in very small and blurred writing. It is redrawn here only as a schematic outline with the legible names (قبائلِ عرب, شام, ربع الخالی, حضرموت, عمان); the individual tribe names inside the map are illegible and are not reproduced. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1.
